summary: RiffMaster backend fully validated against preview URL. 24/24 pytest cases passed covering health, lessons (seeded, sorted, 404), auth guards on all protected endpoints (/auth/me, /me/progress, /me/complete-lesson, /me/log-session, /chat/history, /chat/message, /tts), auth exchange error path (401 on bogus session_id), bearer-based authenticated flow using an injected user_sessions row, progress/XP/streak logic, replay XP decay, lesson 404, log-session, Studio Rat badge after 10 sessions, real Gemini chat (text + vision JPEG with real features), chat history (no _id/user_id leak), TTS generate + MP3 fetch (Content-Type audio/mpeg, non-empty). No MongoDB _id leaks found anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, FastAPI will drop these eventually).

chat_message swallows LLM exceptions and still returns 200 with an 'offline' fallback text, which can hide integration regressions. Consider logging a metric or returning a flag field like 'degraded': true so clients/tests can detect.
complete_lesson replay XP formula uses max(10, xp_gained // 3); for low-XP lessons this gives flat 16 (l_posture) which is fine but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md, inserted one TEST_ user doc + user_sessions row via pymongo in session-scoped fixture; cleaned up users/user_sessions/progress/chat_messages for that user_id on teardown. Also generated a small valid 120x120 JPEG with a guitar silhouette (real edges/features) at /app/backend/tests/_guitar_b64.txt for the vision chat test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_riffmaster_api.py is reusable. Base URL hardcoded to https://riff-mentor.preview.emergentagent.com (preview). Mongo + .env read via conftest. Fixture `test_user` provisions a fresh bearer token and cleans up. Tests cover auth-gated endpoints, XP/streak/badges, Gemini chat (text + vision), TTS. If retesting, just re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`.
